description: Files in the document archive of one tender from the signed-in company's 'Moje przetargi' (tender_id): the tender's documents copied in (copied on the first call when the archive has none yet, as opening the tender in the app does), the company's uploads and the documents Janusz filled — with type, version and date. Read one with get_tender_file. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.
name: list_tender_files
title: Pliki przetargu w archiwum
